name: Oquillas (Spain)
description: Square blue flag with a yellow diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Oquillas (a castle on red and the letter O on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Oquillas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
